• Episode Overview: The Three Questions About Ishwar**
This episode of *Upanishad Ganga* delves into three fundamental philosophical questions about Ishwar (God) as presented in Hinduism:
• Does Ishwar truly exist?
• If so, why can’t we see Him?
• What is His role in the universe?
